text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

You and the successful candidate are both women, and so was the whole panel. An all-women panel choosing between two women tells you essentially nothing about sex bias — there's no comparison group. Raising it would likely read as a weak grievance and undercut the stronger points you actually have.

Those stronger points: you hold a master's and a professional licence against a bachelor's degree, and twelve years of municipal planning experience. If the role was genuinely weighted toward consultation skills, that should be visible in the posted criteria — ask for them.

The real issue is the unanswered request. Follow up in writing, cite any applicable access-to-information or recruitment-record rules, and set a deadline. Possible age-related factors are worth watching, but you have no evidence yet.
